question: Which statements about abstract classes in Java are true? (Select all that apply.)
option_b: They can be instantiated directly with new
option_d: They must contain at least one abstract method
explanation: Abstract classes can have constructors (called by subclasses) and concrete methods. They cannot be instantiated directly, and an abstract class is allowed to have zero abstract methods.
